description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Traces' class, including setup of trace data, testing trace retrieval, slicing by time and frames, iteration, and handling of empty or unavailable frame mappings.

methods.name: getTrace
methods.description: Tests retrieval of traces by type, verifying correct entries are returned or undefined if not present.

methods.name: sliceTime
methods.description: Tests slicing of traces over specific time ranges, including empty, full, middle, front, and back slices.

methods.name: sliceFrames
methods.description: Tests slicing of traces over frame indices, including empty, full, middle, front, and back slices.

methods.name: forEachTrace
methods.description: Verifies iteration over all traces and their entries.

methods.name: forEachFrame
methods.description: Verifies extraction of all frames from traces.

methods.name: supports empty traces
methods.description: Tests behavior with traces that have no entries or frame mappings.

methods.name: supports unavailable frame mapping
methods.description: Tests behavior when frame mappings are undefined.
